title: How to start a return
body: Go to Orders > select the item > Start Return. Print the prepaid label and drop the package at any partner carrier location within 14 days of creating the return.

title: Where is my refund?
body: Refunds are issued to your original payment method 5-7 business days after the warehouse receives your return. Bank processing may add 2-3 days.

title: Tracking your package
body: Open Orders and click Track Package. Tracking updates may take up to 24 hours to appear after the label is created.

title: Package marked delivered but not received
body: Check with neighbors and around your property. Wait 48 hours, as carriers sometimes mark packages delivered early. After 48 hours, contact support to open a lost-package claim.

title: Resetting your password
body: Click 'Forgot password' on the sign-in page and follow the email link. The link expires after 1 hour.

title: Account locked
body: After 5 failed login attempts your account is locked for 30 minutes. It will unlock automatically.

title: Cancelling ShopNest Plus
body: Go to Account > Memberships > Cancel. Monthly members keep benefits until the end of the period. Annual members may be eligible for a prorated refund.

title: Damaged item received
body: Report damage within 14 days via Orders > Report a Problem. Attach photos for items over $75. We will send a replacement or refund.

title: International shipping and duties
body: We ship to 42 countries. Duties and taxes are collected on delivery unless you chose DDP at checkout.

title: Changing your shipping address
body: Addresses can be changed within 1 hour of placing the order from the Orders page. After that, contact the carrier directly.

title: Warranty claims
body: Electronics include a 1-year warranty. Submit a claim with your order ID and a description of the defect via Orders > Warranty Claim.

title: Gift receipts and exchanges
body: Gift recipients can exchange items using the gift receipt code. Refunds go to the gift giver's original payment method.

title: Using promo codes
body: Enter promo codes at checkout. Only one code per order. Codes cannot be applied after the order is placed.

title: Payment declined
body: Verify the billing address matches your card statement. Try another card or contact your bank if the issue persists.
